equity.equity_measurement: Groups are countries classified by WHO region, World Bank income level and Gavi eligibility or transition; country income groups are not SPDs under the brief. Zero-dose status is framed as a marker of poor access, not as a social position.

notes: The design is not named, so surveillance/descriptive was inferred. The Gavi weighted averages are means weighted across countries, which is arithmetic, not survey weighting. Using 2020 estimates for 18 nonreporting countries is a fixed fill-in, not imputation.
view_issues: MCV1 2020 coverage is 84% in the opening paragraph but 83% in the results. Footnote § gives the reporting cutoff as July 7, 2021, while the limitations give July 7, 2022. The prepass weighting cue is a weighted average of country values, not survey weighting.
